priorityDecision: Use P41-16 donor labels in their native coordinate scene for source-based nuclei, BodyParts3D for the missing bilateral insula/internal capsule in a separately sourced scene, and UW CT for skull-base foramina in its own scene. Do not merge these disparate spaces without validated registration.
anatomicalAccuracyClaim: Source provenance and numerical coordinate consistency are verified. This is not independent expert anatomical validation, and does not establish complete or error-free nuclear boundaries.

sources.name: NextBrain donor P41-16 (case 2), registered histology label blocks
sources.status: asset produced; nucleus labels only with native background
sources.licenseEvidence: Official Figshare API lists CC0 and directly links the UCL registered-data repositories including P41-16. The MIT license of the separate web viewer is not used as evidence for data permission.
sources.format: 40 uint16 NIfTI label blocks with individual native affines; corresponding donor T2w MRI and block-index volume
sources.originalSampling: Histology reconstruction uses 0.1 mm in-plane grids, 0.25 or 0.5 mm section spacing before registration scaling. Ex vivo MRI approximately 0.4 mm isotropic. NIfTI header spacings after transforms vary by block.
sources.headerUnitsNote: P41 NIfTI xyzt_units is unspecified; units are interpreted in millimetres from the published MRI protocol and documented RAS transforms, not inferred from voxel indices alone.
sources.geometry: 33 label segments (29 nuclear targets, 4 source residual/white-matter context labels); raw float32 positions and uint32 triangle indices, RAS mm. Target labels marching cubes level0.5 at every source voxel. No smoothing, filling, mirroring, fitting or component deletion.
sources.geometryContext: Context labels are sampled every fourth source voxel in each axis; exact displaySpacingMm is stored per part. This is not uniformly 0.4 mm because the source section direction has larger spacing.
limits: Single donor hemisphere. No bilateral reconstruction is claimed.
No original label for internal-capsule IDs73,115,204,258 in these blocks.
Blocks can leave seams or overlap; no seam welding or invented interpolation performed. Source boundary open mesh edges are retained.
Tiny local labels447,464,520 must not be described as complete nuclei. All segment completeNucleusClaim flags are false.
Source context labels580 and662 are residual tissue labels within a partition; they do not contain the other labelled nuclei and do not form complete pons/medulla envelopes.
Published landmark registration error about0.99±0.51mm across250 pairs is a dataset-level result, not a per-label accuracy guarantee.
No complete cranial nerve pathways emerge from these nucleus-only assets.
sources.coordinateValidationMeaning: 239 non-placeholder author ontology locations were transformed into native block coordinates:213 exactly hit the corresponding label voxel and all239 were within1mm of it. All40 block affines agree with official display transforms after only display-plane rotations and source slice-order reversals, max slice-coordinate error3.51e-6 voxels. These tests validate coordinates, not anatomical boundary accuracy.

sources.name: NextBrain 3dAtlas maximum-probability volume
sources.status: research evidence only; not proposed as complete nuclei
sources.content: 333 non-background labels; one pooled left-oriented hemisphere. Authors flip3right hemispheres and combine with2left hemispheres; retained cortex name ctx-rh-insula is an ontology identifier, not the volume orientation.
limitations: Argmax gives the most probable label in each voxel, not a full probability-envelope boundary. Small competing nuclear labels shrink strongly.
The large LUT includes labels absent from the actual image.
No added mirror should be presented as a real second hemisphere.

sources.name: CerebrA on MNI-ICBM2009c symmetric template
sources.status: optional research source, not integrated in this revision
sources.meaning: Mindboggle101 anatomical cortical and subcortical labels registered and manually corrected on the symmetric2009c average template.
limitations: Symmetric population template, not an individual bilateral brain; cannot model actual lateral asymmetry.
No fine brainstem nuclei and no independent internal-capsule partition.
Do not transfer coordinates to MNI6 or Z-Anatomy by identity or an unvalidated affine.

sources.name: NextBrain 200-micrometre manual segmentation of Edlow ex vivo right hemisphere
sources.status: LUT and license checked; not needed for this revision
limitations: Only the right hemisphere is manually labelled. Some LUT subcortical strings retain Left-, so dataset provenance must govern side interpretation.
No dedicated internal-capsule labels in the supplied LUT.
Its simplified nuclei are less comprehensive than the raw histology blocks.

sources.name: Brainstem Navigator v1.0
sources.license: Non-commercial research; redistribution of originals or information/files derived from them outside the organization is prohibited.
sources.action: Read the official pre-download agreement. Did not accept it and did not download restricted masks.

sources.name: JHU ICBM-DTI81 white-matter labels
sources.status: candidate reviewed; not needed when BodyParts3D original capsule is available
sources.license: FSL noncommercial terms, including source/notice conditions for redistribution; not CC BY-SA simply because Harvard-Oxford was relicensed.
sources.meaning: Hand-labelled deep white-matter regions in a standard-space mean of81 diffusion tensor maps.
limitations: Labels include anterior limb, posterior limb and retrolenticular capsule, not a separately delineated genu or whole capsule.
FSL published an orientation/label correction in2021; raw historical LONI headers must not be trusted without that correction.
A tract atlas mask is not an axon reconstruction or complete histological capsule boundary.

sources.name: BodyParts3D original source data
sources.license: CC BY4.0 as stated on official archive license page updated2025-02-27

limitations: Use original same-source neighbours; modified Z-Anatomy mesh coordinates are not automatically the same spatial reference.
Whole internal-capsule object does not prove separately delineated histological limbs.

p41MeshQA.outwardWinding: gradient_direction=ascent; triangle orientation is inverted for negative-determinant native affine. Every closed source part asserts positive signed volume.

mriEvidence.interpretation: Source labels remain visibly partial/fragmented where acquired or reconstructed that way. The overlay does not fill missing tissue.
